{{Icon|Crush icon|'''Crush'''}} is a type of debuff and damage instance applied to enemies in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

When an operator applies Crush to an enemy that is not currently {{G|Vulnerable}}, a stack of Vulnerability is applied instead. Otherwise, it consumes all Vulnerability stacks on the target and applies '''Crushed''': Deals {{Color|300% – 750% ATK|1d}} {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} of the triggering operator.

The following table shows the amount of damage dealt to the target based on the {{G|Status Level}} or the number of stacks consumed:

{|class="wikitable wikitable-mobile"
!Status Level
!Crush DMG
|-
|I
|{{Color|300% ATK|1d}}
|-
|II
|{{Color|450% ATK|1d}}
|-
|III
|{{Color|600% ATK|1d}}
|-
|IV
|{{Color|750% ATK|1d}}
|-
|}

Some skills such as {{Icon|Mi Fu icon|[[Mi Fu]]'s}} {{Color|World Splitter|7}} deal their damage as Crush DMG and are increased by [[Arts Intensity]] but not {{G|Link}} or Battle Skill DMG Bonus. This damage is not considered as being '''Crushed''' or as applying a Physical Status such as for the purposes of {{Icon|Pogranichnik icon|[[Pogranichnik]]'s}} {{Color|Shieldguard Banner, Forward|7}}.

== Calculations ==
===Physical DMG Instance/Crush DMG Instance===
{{Main|Damage calculation}}
Some operator combat skills are able to deal increased Crush DMG under certain conditions. This stacks <u>multiplicatively</u> with the base Crush DMG and with other damage multipliers.

== Changelog ==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b>
** {{Color|<u>Knock Back</u>|2}} renamed to {{G|Crush}}.
** {{G|Crush}} changed.
*** <b>New:</b> When an operator applies {{G|Crush}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} all {{G|Vulnerable|Vulnerability}} stacks to deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} based on the number of stacks consumed.
*** <b>Old:</b> When an operator applies {{Color|<u>Knocked Back</u>|2}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the debuff to deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} and apply {{Color|Stagger|8}}.
* <b>Beta Test I</b>
** {{Color|<u>Knock Back</u>|2}} added.
*** When an operator applies {{Color|<u>Knocked Back</u>|2}} to a {{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} the debuff to deal additional {{Color|Physical DMG|2}} and apply {{Color|Stagger|8}}.
*** When an operator applies {{Color|<u>Knocked Back</u>|2}} to a non-{{G|Vulnerable}} enemy, apply {{G|Vulnerable}} instead.
}}
